metadata.name: pacto
metadata.description: Escrow for group orders on Solana

accounts.name: signer
docs: Buyer for confirm, anyone for release_expired (permissionless crank),
arbiter for resolve.

accounts.name: participation
docs: Seeds bind this account to (group_order, buyer), so a second join by the
same buyer tops up the existing position instead of re-initializing it.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton protocol configuration.

fields.name: allowed_mint
docs: Only this mint may be used for new group orders. `Pubkey::default()`
disables the allowlist. Prevents transfer-fee or confidential mints
from breaking vault accounting.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: None uses the protocol default arbiter.

types.name: GroupOrder
docs: One escrowed group order.

fields.name: details_uri
docs: Link to the organizer's GO post (X, Instagram, Discord) with full details.

fields.name: image_uri
docs: Cover image for the order.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Snapshot of the protocol fee at creation so admin changes never
affect a running order.

types.name: Participation
docs: One buyer's position in a group order. Closed when it reaches a
terminal state so the buyer recovers rent.
